note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; only the alate is described, soldiers and workers being undescribed; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated; the original notes that some measurements were taken from a paratype figure published by Thakur (1981).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and pronotum dark chestnut brown, antennae and postclypeus yellowish brown, pronotum with a yellow T-shaped mark and shoulder spots, meso- and metanotum paler than the pronotum, abdominal dorsum dark chestnut brown, venter distinctly paler, wings brown. Pilosity of head and body moderate, of two kinds, long and short. Head capsule subcircular, width including compound eyes greater than the length (head length to base of mandibles 1.80, maximum width including compound eyes 2.52 mm). Fontanelle minute, slightly raised. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.60, minimum diameter 0.53 mm); ocelli oval (long diameter 0.19 mm), separated from the compound eye by more than their long diameter (0.28 mm). Antennae 19-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 equal in length to segment 3, segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus with length less than half the width, anterior part straight, posterior part subcircular. Pronotum sub-trapezoidal (length 1.28, width 2.44 mm), anterior margin weakly concave at the middle, posterior margin broadly concave. Wings long and narrow, fore wing length 24.0 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Bose (1984) treated this species and O. parvidens as two separate valid species, whereas Thakur (1981) regarded O. parvidens as a synonym of this species. Chhotani agreed with Bose and considered the present species restricted to southern India, with O. parvidens distributed in the northern and north-eastern parts of the Indian subcontinent; the alates of the two are very similar, the fore wing of the present species being only slightly shorter. The species is at present known only from the type locality.
